name: Knight Lapis
source:
"Green breath that inherits the earth!!"

Knight Lapis is a member of the Morning Star Knights. She is a skilled fighter who was dispatched from the headquarters to the Japanese branch, which is weakened and confused after the assassination of its leader, Leonard. 

She is the daughter of the family that owns the Oukazaibatsu which sponsors the Morning Star Knights. Although she can be forceful and high-spirited at times, she is an attractive girl who is friendly, kind and humble. However, she is a semi-compliant artifact and cannot demonstrate the same level of power as Ignis as a Magical Girl.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/E0epa7j.jpeg]official character description[/url]]
